name: repeat-production
description: repeat production on a barracks: one Ranger queued by hand is built again and again through the barracks' own queue; when money minus the cost would fall below the reserve it waits (the money stays); with money again it goes on; switched off, the Ranger in the queue is finished and no more come. The barracks (AmericaBarracks) is made by the script; without a power plant it builds slowly, which only makes the waits longer.
log: ^ASSIST repeat production: factory \d+ on \(nothing yet\), reserve 0

log.match: ^ASSIST repeat production: factory \d+ queues AmericaInfantryRanger again \(money \d+, cost \d+, reserve 0\)

log: ^ASSIST repeat production: factory \d+ waits: money \d+, cost \d+, reserve 1000
^ASSIST repeat production: factory \d+ queues AmericaInfantryRanger again \(money 5000, cost \d+, reserve 1000\)
